Kashiraja.note: King of Kashi; his three daughters were carried off from their svayamvara by Bhishma as brides for Vichitravirya.

people.Amba: Eldest Kashi princess; rejected because she loved another, she vowed vengeance on Bhishma and was reborn in Panchala as Shikhandi.
people.Ambika: Kashi princess wed to Vichitravirya; mother, through Vyasa's niyoga, of Dhritarashtra, she shut her eyes, so her son was born blind.
people.Ambalika: Kashi princess wed to Vichitravirya; mother, through Vyasa's niyoga, of Pandu, she paled at the sight of Vyasa, so her son was born pale.
people.Balandhara: A princess of Kashi; wife of Bhima.
